WITH transaction_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM main.customer_transactions
),
node_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM main.customer_nodes
),
population AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM node_ids) AS node_customers,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_ids) AS transaction_customers,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_ids JOIN node_ids USING (customer_id)) AS customers_in_both
)
SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', t.txn_date) AS month,
    t.txn_type,
    COUNT(*) AS transactions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS participating_customers,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(t.customer_id) AS missing_ids,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(t.txn_amount) AS missing_amounts,
    MIN(t.txn_amount) AS min_amount,
    MAX(t.txn_amount) AS max_amount,
    p.node_customers,
    p.transaction_customers,
    p.customers_in_both
FROM main.customer_transactions AS t
CROSS JOIN population AS p
GROUP BY month, t.txn_type
ORDER BY month, t.txn_type;

item.text: Both customer tables contain the same 500 customers. Transactions cover January through April, so May through December each have zero positive balances under the monthly calculation. I’ll return every month tied for the lowest count.

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    VALUES ('2020-01-01')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2020-12-01'
),
customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM main.customer_nodes
),
balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        date(txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE txn_type
                WHEN 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                ELSE 0
            END) AS balance
    FROM main.customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date >= '2020-01-01'
      AND txn_date < '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id, month_start
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT
        m.month_start,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.balance > 0) AS positive_customers,
        AVG(COALESCE(b.balance, 0)) AS average_balance
    FROM months AS m
    CROSS JOIN customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN balances AS b
      ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id
     AND b.month_start = m.month_start
    GROUP BY m.month_start
)
SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', hi.month_start) AS highest_count_month,
    hi.average_balance AS highest_count_month_average,
    strftime('%Y-%m', lo.month_start) AS lowest_count_month,
    lo.average_balance AS lowest_count_month_average,
    hi.average_balance - lo.average_balance AS average_balance_difference
FROM monthly AS hi
CROSS JOIN monthly AS lo
WHERE hi.positive_customers = (SELECT MAX(positive_customers) FROM monthly)
  AND lo.positive_customers = (SELECT MIN(positive_customers) FROM monthly)
ORDER BY hi.month_start, lo.month_start
LIMIT 1000
